name: a-place-freed-in-a-step-is-taken-at-the-end-of-the-step
description: A place that comes free is taken when the step that freed it is over, by the call that has waited longest: `three` cuts `one` at 10 and waits behind `two`; the `reserve` of `two` at a follows everything else that signal caused (the `reserve` at b).
